name: Feature request
about: Describe a workload and the capability it needs
title: ''
---

## What are you trying to do?

Describe the workflow and the query or operation you cannot express today.

## Current approach

What do you use now? What fails or takes too much work? Include approximate nodes, retained versions, update ordering and result sizes where useful.

## Proposed behavior and success measure

Give a small input/output example and explain how you would verify that the change solves the problem. Mention acceptable tradeoffs.
